Author:     Max Emig <mozilla@emigm.ax>

    Bug 184869 - Fix handling of unreferenced inline children in multipart/related as attachment. r=tobyp
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D296568

diff --git a/mail/test/browser/attachment/browser.toml b/mail/test/browser/attachment/browser.toml

--- a/mail/test/browser/attachment/browser.toml

 subsuite = "thunderbird"
 support-files = ["data/**"]

 ["browser_attachment.js"]
 
 ["browser_attachmentEvents.js"]

 ["browser_attachmentSize.js"]

diff --git a/mail/test/browser/attachment/browser_unreferencedRelatedPart.js b/mail/test/browser/attachment/browser_unreferencedRelatedPart.js
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..78acfbeab0d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mail/test/browser/attachment/browser_unreferencedRelatedPart.js
@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+/* This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
+ * License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
+ * file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/. */
+
+"use strict";
+
+var { get_about_message, open_message_from_file } = ChromeUtils.importESModule(
+  "resource://testing-common/mail/FolderDisplayHelpers.sys.mjs"
+);
+
+/**
+ * Check that unreferenced Content-Disposition: inline parts inside
+ * multipart/related surface as attachments with intact content. Size is used
+ * as a proxy for intact content; the empty ZIP payload is binary-safe so the
+ * same size can be asserted on Windows and macOS/Linux alike.
+ */
+add_task(async function test_multiple_unreferenced_related_parts_visible() {
+  const file = new FileUtils.File(
+    getTestFilePath("data/multiple_unreferenced_related_parts.eml")
+  );
+  const msgc = await open_message_from_file(file);
+  const aboutMessage = get_about_message(msgc);
+
+  EventUtils.synthesizeMouseAtCenter(
+    aboutMessage.document.getElementById("attachmentToggle"),
+    {},
+    aboutMessage
+  );
+
+  const attachmentList = aboutMessage.document.getElementById("attachmentList");
+  Assert.equal(
+    attachmentList.itemCount,
+    2,
+    "both unreferenced inline parts should surface as attachments"
+  );
+
+  const attachments = Array.from(
+    { length: 2 },
+    (_, i) => attachmentList.getItemAtIndex(i).attachment
+  );
+
+  for (const [i, attachment] of attachments.entries()) {
+    Assert.equal(
+      attachment.name,
+      `dummy${i + 1}.zip`,
+      `attachment ${i + 1} should be named dummy${i + 1}.zip`
+    );
+    Assert.equal(
+      attachment.size,
+      22,
+      "attachment size should match 22-byte empty ZIP"
+    );
+    Assert.ok(!(await attachment.isEmpty()), "attachment should not be empty");
+  }
+
+  await BrowserTestUtils.closeWindow(msgc);
+});
diff --git a/mail/test/browser/attachment/data/multiple_unreferenced_related_parts.eml b/mail/test/browser/attachment/data/multiple_unreferenced_related_parts.eml
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..7e20c964932
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mail/test/browser/attachment/data/multiple_unreferenced_related_parts.eml
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+Subject: Multiple unreferenced inline parts in multipart/related
+From: sender@example.invalid
+To: recipient@example.invalid
+Date: Sat, 01 Jan 2000 00:00:00 +0545
+Message-ID: <multiple-unreferenced-inline-parts@test.invalid>
+MIME-Version: 1.0
+Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary="=_mixed_boundary"
+
+--=_mixed_boundary
+
+This message contains two empty ZIP files (dummy1.zip, dummy2.zip) as unreferenced inline parts. Both should appear as 22-byte attachments.
+
+--=_mixed_boundary
+Content-Type: multipart/related; boundary="=_rel_boundary"; type="application/zip"
+
+--=_rel_boundary
+Content-Type: application/zip; name="dummy1.zip"
+Content-Disposition: inline; filename="dummy1.zip"
+Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64
+
+UEsFBgAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA==
+
+--=_rel_boundary
+Content-Type: application/zip; name="dummy2.zip"
+Content-Disposition: inline; filename="dummy2.zip"
+Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64
+
+UEsFBgAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA==
+
+--=_rel_boundary--
+
+--=_mixed_boundary--
diff --git a/mailnews/mime/src/mimemrel.cpp b/mailnews/mime/src/mimemrel.cpp
index cd831df0227..3704bd89ba4 100644
--- a/mailnews/mime/src/mimemrel.cpp
+++ b/mailnews/mime/src/mimemrel.cpp
@@ -425,15 +425,21 @@ static bool MimeMultipartRelated_output_child_p(MimeObject* obj,
       }
     }
 
-    if (location) {
-      char* base_url =
-          MimeHeaders_get(child->headers, HEADER_CONTENT_BASE, false, false);
-      char* absolute =
-          MakeAbsoluteURL(base_url ? base_url : relobj->base_url, location);
-
-      PR_FREEIF(base_url);
-      PR_Free(location);
-      if (absolute) {
+    if (!location) {
+      // Without Content-ID or Content-Location this part is unreachable via
+      // cid: rewriting. Output it as a normal attachment so data is not
+      // silently discarded.
+      return true;
+    }
+
+    char* base_url =
+        MimeHeaders_get(child->headers, HEADER_CONTENT_BASE, false, false);
+    char* absolute =
+        MakeAbsoluteURL(base_url ? base_url : relobj->base_url, location);
+
+    PR_FREEIF(base_url);
+    PR_Free(location);
+    if (absolute) {
         nsAutoCString partnum;
         nsAutoCString imappartnum;
         partnum.Adopt(mime_part_address(child));
@@ -545,7 +551,6 @@ static bool MimeMultipartRelated_output_child_p(MimeObject* obj,
           }
         }
       }
-    }
   } else {
     /* Ah-hah!  We're the head object.  */
     relobj->head_loaded = true;
@@ -644,6 +649,9 @@ static int MimeMultipartRelated_parse_child_line(MimeObject* obj,
       }
       return MimePartBufferWrite(relobj->child_bufs[idx], line, length);
     }
+    if (kid->output_p)
+      return ((MimeMultipartClass*)&MIME_SUPERCLASS)
+          ->parse_child_line(obj, line, length, first_line_p);
     return 0;
   }
title: Bug 184869 - Fix handling of unreferenced inline children in multipart/related as attachment. r=tobyp
